correctness.rationale: For the resolvent B=(μI+L(K_mn))^-1, block inversion gives within-left off-diagonal c·n/(μ+n), within-right c·m/(μ+m), across c=1/[μ(μ+m+n)]. Two-class Rademacher variance is 4c² times weighted same-color unordered pairs, so minimizing it is maximizing C(x,y)=αx(m−x)+βy(n−y)+nx+my−2xy. For interior grid points, C(x+1,y−1)+C(x−1,y+1)−2C=2(2−α−β)>0; all optima lie on boundary up to color reversal. Concave edge sequences give exact integer optimizers and the proper-coloring transition α(m−1)≤n and β(n−1)≤m; both inequalities cannot fail together. Direct exact enumeration of 147 small cases corroborated, including star (m,n,μ)=(10,1,1) variance 1/4 versus 5/16.
